dsr_pbo: not calculated; global trial count unreconciled; history consumed

selection_policy.primary: maximize minimum cash_excess_sharpe across all four cost/delay cells
selection_policy.ties: minimum CAGR, worst drawdown, lower maximum turnover, stable version ID

inverse_ETF_model: SH/PSQ/TBF actual adjusted open/close prices; long units of daily inverse funds, including embedded expenses and daily compounding; no synthetic minus-index returns
previously_consumed_later_data: Fifth-round July31..Sep30 equity and September crypto observations already inspected; no new independent later check in this round
missing_asset_policy: All ETH/PAXG segments resolved by decision-day available full history; never choose a latest future segment or fill gaps
fundamental_scope: Settled funding is a public crowding feature only; no derivative, funding cashflow, staking, basis income or broad fundamentals claim. Macro latest snapshots remain revision-exposed diagnostic-only.
stop_policy: One frozen run,8 candidates/52 curves; no return-conditioned rescue; macro candidates remain registered diagnostic-only; preserve any failed implementation in a separate directory.
structural_question: Add settled funding crowding and closed taker-flow permissions to staged spot recovery; use revision-exposed credit/financial conditions and curve signals to fund defensive source reallocations.
accounting: Actual long spot and fund units; cash and gross book trade fees explicit. Capital transfers net zero and excluded from book profits. Closed crypto episodes and capital source net contributions separately reconciled.

c60.funding_core: half BTC/ETH original core targets individually when own positive 7-day mean daily settled rate ranks at or above75th percentile of preceding180 seven-day means; satellites unchanged
c60.funding_all: half all original spot risk targets if either BTC or ETH is crowded by the same funding rule
c60.flow_entry: original BTC/ETH targets require own prior20-day quote-weighted taker imbalance>0; satellites require BTC imbalance>0; missing feature is neutral and explicitly counted
c60.funding_flow: funding_all times flow_entry, fixed factorial interaction
c60.execution: same tenth-round staged recovery and owned vintage reductions; modified nominal targets may create information-driven recovery/exit; original universe and selection unchanged
c60.available: funding and closed spot flow through prior UTC day only; no received funding PnL, derivative positions or fabricated stablecoin yield

g20.nfci_cash: latest NFCI>0 halves original selected equity instruments; released budget to BIL
g20.credit_cash: latest NFCI Credit contribution>0 halves original selected equity instruments; released budget to BIL
g20.credit_gold: same credit rule but released equity capital buys actual GLD units
g20.curve_credit: credit contribution>0 OR lagged10y-3m slope<0 halves selected equity instruments; released budget to BIL
g20.timing: NFCI reference Friday+7 calendar days, stale after21 days; slope2 equity-session lag, stale after7 days; changed targets trade at original T+1/T+2
g20.missing: missing source feature is neutral; no backward fill or fabricated zero values
g20.qualification: latest macro snapshots have revision exposure; all four G20 information candidates are diagnostic-only and excluded from current leader selection
